_naming_rationale: The name deliberately stays 3-part: AccountDetector.swift does NOT do Luhn — its header comment says 'Account is the catch-all for numbers users call accounts but that carry no intrinsic structure' and detect() has no checksum gate (only regex + ContextWindowScorer), so is_checksum_gated=false and a 'luhn' algorithm slot would be false. The 4-part pii.account.context.v1 alternative was considered for parity but mechanism-honesty wins over shape-uniformity.

Every Swift detector symbol that wires into MatchAuditRecord.ruleID maps to ≥ 1 catalog entry. detectAddresses is invoked unconditionally by PIIDetector.detect (line 124) and emits with PIIKind.address → defaultRuleID 'address.regex' (line 269). AddressComponentsGazetteer is consulted for cross-check but the rule is the address pattern; source_artifact stays null (not gazetteer-driven the way DL/passport are).

BarcodeDetector wraps Vision's VNDetectBarcodesRequest (broad symbology set: QR, PDF417, Aztec, DataMatrix, 1D) and emits rect-based DetectionResult(kind: .pii(.barcode)) with VNBarcodeObservation.confidence; matchedText carries the decoded payload when Vision extracts one. The 'barcode.vision' string itself lives in PIIDetector.defaultRuleID(for: .barcode) (PIIDetector.swift:419) — the engine's canonical kind-to-ruleID mapping, applied by ensureRationales to any PIIMatch lacking a detector-built rationale. As of Resecta cbbf0c8 the barcode path flows rect-based through DetectionOrchestrator rather than through PIIDetector.detect, so the string reaches a MatchAuditRecord only via that mapping. Row added by the 2026-06-10 reconciliation: the emit-string scan surfaces the switch arm, and the unreachable_fallbacks alternative was rejected because nothing overrides 'barcode.vision' — it is the only ruleID assigned to the .barcode kind (unlike ssn.regex, which SSNStateMachine supersedes). 4-part rule_id puts the load-bearing mechanism in the algorithm slot ('vision'), parity with pii.cc.luhn.v1 / pii.name.nltagger.v1. source_artifact null: Vision framework, no pipeline gazetteer.

_naming_rationale: Triple gate: regex → Luhn → prefix. is_checksum_gated=true (Luhn must pass). The 4-part shape pii.cc.luhn.v1 keeps parity with pii.npi.luhn.v1 / pii.dea.checksum.v1 / pii.ssn.state_machine.v1; Luhn is the load-bearing checksum so 'luhn' is the most-honest algorithm slot.

DEA registration: 2 letters + 7 digits with checksum (oddSum + 2*evenSum mod 10 == digit[6]). DEADetector.detect at line 50 hard-gates on isValidChecksum. Note Swift emits ruleID='dea.letter-check' with structuralValidator signal name='dea.checksum'; the catalog rule_id 'pii.dea.checksum.v1' aligns with the structural-validator semantic.

Driver's-license patterns are gazetteer-driven (the standalone dl_patterns.json). source_artifact='dl_patterns.json' — the gazetteer destination is fixed even where the engine-half regex is still inline in PIIDetector; the Swift loader consumes dl_patterns.json.

DOBDetector struct: structured DOB with age-proximity heuristic. Structural validation (M 1-12, D 1-31, Y 1900-2030) is not a checksum so is_checksum_gated=false. Doctype-gated runsDOB (false on .financial). Doctype-gating policy lives in PIIDetector, not the catalog.
EIN: 9-digit format XX-XXXXXXX with two-digit area-code prefix. Pattern-only; no checksum.
Email regex with the dot-handling fix; RFC 5321 length cap downstream. No checksum.

ITIN: 9XX-XX-XXXX with second-group constraints (70-88, 90-92, 94-99). Pattern-only; no checksum. The ITIN-specific negative-context cross-reference lives in the candidates / engine, not the catalog. itin.yy-bucket is the ContextWindowScorer migration's rationale ruleID — same rule family, SSN-style two-emissions-one-row fold.

License-plate label-anchored regex + LicensePlateContextKeywords scoring. The per-state custom-terms template ships engine-side; rule_id stable. Note Swift emits 'licensePlate.labeled' (camelCase); catalog uses snake_case-friendly 'pii.lp.v1' to satisfy the rule_id pattern (`[a-z_]+`) without losing meaning.

MRN/MR# prefix labeled pattern (mrnPatternLabeled at lines 686-689; emit-site in detectMedicalRecords at 707-743). The original single pii.mrn.v1 rollup is split into three per-pattern rows for finer-grained audit slicing; rule_ids align 1:1 with the Swift ruleID strings (mrn.labeled / mrn.patientID / mrn.institution). Pattern-only, no checksum.

'Patient ID:' labeled pattern (mrnPatternPatientID at lines 692-695; emit-site in detectMedicalRecords at 707-743). Catalog rule_id snake_cases 'patient_id' to keep within `[a-z_]+` per the rule_id pattern; Swift emit-string 'mrn.patientID' (camelCase) is captured in _emitted_rule_id. One of the 3-row MRN split. Pattern-only, no checksum.

Institution-prefixed shape ABC-1234567 (mrnPatternInstitution at lines 699-702; emit-site in detectMedicalRecords at 707-743). Most context-dependent of the three (same shape collides with case-IDs in non-medical docs) so context-scored. One of the 3-row MRN split. Pattern-only, no checksum.

Every detector → ≥1 catalog entry. detectNames is invoked unconditionally by PIIDetector.detect (line 151). NLTagger + NameGazetteer (Bloom validation) — but the algorithm is NLTagger so 4-part shape pii.name.nltagger.v1 mirrors pii.ssn.state_machine.v1 / pii.dea.checksum.v1. NameGazetteer Bloom files (surnames.bloom / given-names.bloom / gazetteer_manifest.json) are augmentation, not the rule, so source_artifact=null. The 3-part pii.name.v1 alternative was considered; the algorithm slot stays to surface the platform dependency in the rule_id itself.

10-digit NPI with CMS Luhn-80840 checksum (NPILuhn80840.isValid hard-gates at line 36). Note Swift emits ruleID='npi.80840' (algorithm-version) while the catalog uses 'pii.npi.luhn.v1' (algorithm-class).

Passport patterns are gazetteer-driven. source_artifact='passport_patterns.json' — the gazetteer destination is fixed; the Swift loader consumes it. Cuba (CU) excluded entirely on OFAC sanctions grounds.
US phone regex (NANP). No checksum.

SignatureHeuristicDetector finds OCR blocks labeled signature/sign here/signed/authorized signature, defines a candidate rect beside or below the label, and scores it with a pure-Swift 128x64 Sobel pass (ink-density + curvature thresholds, both must clear) — emitting DetectionResult(kind: .pii(.signatureCandidate)). Triage-only by design: DetectionOrchestrator routes .signatureCandidate to pendingTriage, never auto-applied, and PIICategory(piiKind:) returns nil for it. The 'signature.heuristic' string lives in PIIDetector.defaultRuleID(for: .signatureCandidate) (PIIDetector.swift:422), whose adjacent comment notes the kind is never emitted via PIIDetector but the switch is exhaustive over PIIKind — i.e. the string is the canonical ruleID for the kind, reachable only through the kind-to-ruleID mapping as of Resecta cbbf0c8. Row added by the 2026-06-10 reconciliation on the same grounds as pii.barcode.vision.v1: nothing overrides this string, so the unreachable_fallbacks set (reserved for arms a real detector always supersedes) would mischaracterize it. 4-part rule_id with the mechanism in the algorithm slot ('heuristic' — confidence is an uncalibrated density/curvature blend per the module header). source_artifact null: pure-Swift heuristic, no pipeline gazetteer.

_naming_rationale: ABA routing number: 9-digit format with ABA mod-10 checksum (weights 3-7-1-3-7-1-3-7-1) and valid first-two-digit prefix enforcement (ranges 01-12, 21-32, 61-72, 80). is_checksum_gated=true (ABA checksum must pass). Swift emits ruleID='routingNumber.aba-checksum'; catalog uses 'pii.routing_number.v1' following the existing pii.<category>[.<qualifier>].v1 convention. Added with the routing-number detector; the iOS side landed in the same change.

_naming_rationale: Linear-time state machine + structural validator (excludes 000/666/9XX area, 00 group, 0000 serial). is_checksum_gated=false ('state machine isn't a checksum'). PIIDetector.detectSSNs orchestrates SSNStateMachine.scan + SSNStructuralValidator + context scoring; the rule is anchored to SSNStateMachine since that's the primary candidate generator.
